Background must remain blue and uninterrupted outside the mark. Crisp immaculate edges, no gradients, shadows, glow, texture, glass, outlines, outlines around tile, 3D, phone, frames, additional smaller versions, letters other than the described symbol, wordmark, labels or watermarks. Do not draw a rounded-square container; the whole canvas is the icon surface. All meaning and identity must survive recoloring this exact silhouette to one solid color for Android themed icons. Do not imitate any famous existing logo. Specific concept: A custom distinctive capital T monogram inspired by musical timing and precise timetable slots. A wide strong horizontal cap with softly squared corners and a small intentional vertical break near its right end; the detached right segment is short, the left segment joins a sturdy centred vertical stem. The lower stem has a rounded foot, subtly offset to make the silhouette proprietary. The overall T must be instantly legible, spacious and poised. Three geometric pieces maximum, absolutely no decoration. This is the flagship restrained word-initial option.
